summary: Master Smith Burninate says that when Maltorius left their clan, he took their recipe for fiery flux, worth more than a pristine arcane crystal. Burninate wants the secret plans back and is sure they are near Maltorius, deep in the Slag Pit.

sections.title: The Stolen Recipe
sections.body: Master Smith Burninate calls Maltorius a traitor who left the clan with the recipe for fiery flux. Burninate would bet the recipe came with Maltorius's new promotion among the Dark Irons, and wants the secret plans returned.

sections.title: Into the Slag Pit
sections.body: Burninate is sure the plans are not far from Maltorius, down in the depths of the Slag Pit. The Secret Plans: Fiery Flux are what Burninate wants carried back.

faq.q: Who stole the recipe for fiery flux?
faq.answer: Maltorius, whom Master Smith Burninate calls a traitor to their clan.

aliases: where to find fiery flux plans
faq.answer: Burninate believes they are close to Maltorius, deep in the Cauldron's Slag Pit.

faq.q: Who asks for the plans to be recovered?
faq.answer: It is Burninate, a master smith, who wants them back.

faq.q: Why do the plans matter to Burninate?
faq.answer: Burninate says the recipe for fiery flux is worth more than a pristine arcane crystal, and it was the clan's own secret.
